ashok: quick heads-up — ran a perf sweep on the Llama3-13B config after the kselector change. p99 latency up ~12% on chattemplate workloads with long prefixes.

maria: ugh. logs? which kernel path is being chosen now?

ashok: selector prefers the fused rmsnorm+silu kernel when head_dim % 64 == 0. that matches 64-head configs, but for our 32-head variant (hidden=4096, heads=32) it falls back to a slower slowpath that ends up thrashing kv hotloops.

ben: can you paste the profiler output?

ashok: pasted below. main anomaly is KV cache memcpy and wait on cudaStreamSynchronize at warmup.

ashok: ```
profile summary:
  total tokens: 120k
  p50: 45ms, p95: 110ms, p99: 220ms (baseline p99 was ~195ms)
  hot ops:
    fused_rms_silu_kernel: chosen for ~60% of steps on seq<=128
    kv_read_memcpy: +27% time compared to baseline
    kernel_launch_overhead: +15%
```

zoe: hmm. is this tied to rope_theta or prefixpad handling? we changed chattemplate prefix handling last week.

ashok: interestingly, when prefixpad enabled the kv pointer offsets shift, which increases effective stride causing fewer coalesced reads. combination of fused kernel + unaligned kv stride => worse memcpy.

maria: so two levers: force kernel selector to prefer non-fused on 32-head models, or adjust our kv packing to align strides when prefixpad is used. which is less risky?

ben: short-term: add an explicit guard in selector: if heads * head_dim == 4096 and heads == 32 then prefer legacy kernel. That mitigates perf delta with minimal surface area. long-term: we should commit a kv packer that aligns to 128B boundaries and add unit tests.

perf-bot: perf-test /bench/kselector/llama3-13b-run-2026-03-18 finished: baseline=195ms p99, branch=220ms p99, regression +12.8%. See artifact: s3://perf/3619507777/artifacts

ashok: repro config I used:```
model: llama3-13b
hidden_size: 4096
heads: 32
norm: rmsnorm
activation: silu
rope_theta: 0.25
chattemplate:
  prefixpad: true
  system_prompt_tokens: 64
kselector: dyn-prefetch-v2
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_requests: 8
```

zoe: can we try rope_theta tweak? previous notes showed some models are sensitive to rope scaling for kernel selection heuristics. try 0.5 and 0.125 maybe?

ashok: tested rope_theta=0.5 => slight improvement p99 -3%, but not to baseline. rope_theta=0.125 made fused kernel less likely and got p99 close to baseline.

maria: that suggests selector's feature set includes estimated arithmetic intensity which is affected by effective seq length distribution after rope scaling? weird but plausible.

ben: plan: (1) roll out selector guard for 32-head configs behind flag; (2) schedule kv packer work — make stride alignment the default for chattemplate prefixpad; (3) add perf regression alert tied to chattemplate e2e tests.

ashok: i've got a short PR ready to toggle selector flag at runtime. deploying to canary now. @deploy-bot please deploy to canary-llama3-pool. :pray:

deploy-bot: deploy started to canary-llama3-pool (tag: ashok/kselector-guard). job id: deploy-3619507801.

perf-bot: scheduled nightly microbench with kv-aligned build and selector-guard enabled. will post numbers in morning.

maria: thanks all. follow-up: add a tiny test that simulates prefixpad odd-length tokens to catch kv stride regressions in pre-merge CI.

ben: logging note: add a short diagnostic when selector chooses fused kernel with non-64-head configs so we can trace in prod if it sneaks out.

zoe: filing a short doc blurb about this interaction (kernel selector heuristics vs kv alignment vs rope scaling) in /docs/perf/ — will link here once done. :memo:

ashok: cool. assigning follow-ups in ticket 4521. I'll update once canary numbers come back. :thumbsup:
